meta.description: FLUX.2 Klein 9B character LoKr in the 16 GB laptop memory profile (RTX 5080 Laptop 16 GB, 96 GB RAM, native Windows - NOBLE-G18), trained at 1024. LoKr twin of k9b_laptop_char_lora: identical 1024 / layer offloading (TE 100%, transformer 80%) / quantize + quantize_te (qfloat8 -> torchao float8 under offloading) / low_vram / cached text embeddings + TE unloaded / RAM-served latents / sampling off (1024 [trigger] prompts pre-set) / save every 250 keeping 10 / step table setup - only the network and LR differ. SOURCE: COMMUNITY-DERIVED and UNMEASURED - no LoKr run of Klein exists in this fork and none of these values were tried on the laptop. Community reports (r/StableDiffusion, ai-toolkit users on Klein 9B) claim LoKr reaches likeness faster than LoRA on Klein character training; that is a claim, not a fork result. NETWORK: type lokr, lokr_full_rank true, lokr_factor 8, linear 32/32 + conv 16/16 (the community Klein 9B LoKr config). NOTE: with lokr_full_rank on, toolkit/config_modules.py replaces linear/alpha/conv/conv_alpha with 9999999999 so the second Kronecker factor is never decomposed - the 32/32 and 16/16 values are kept for reference and only matter if you turn full rank off. Factor direction (toolkit/models/lokr.py factorization()): LOWER factor = LARGER network. Factor 4 is the community pick for maximum likeness at more memory and a bigger file; 16 is smaller and also reported to work. LR 5e-5 (half the LoRA preset's 1e-4, same as krea2_char_lokr and the community Klein 9B LoKr config), adamw8bit, sigmoid timesteps, batch 1 x accum 1, 1500 steps. LOADING: the fork's flux2 load path quantizes block-by-block on the GPU and hands blocks to the layer offloader, so the ostris #653 load-time OOM should not apply (read from code, not tested on 16 GB). WINDOWS: set NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > CUDA - Sysmem Fallback Policy = Prefer No Sysmem Fallback; without it a near-ceiling run spills into shared memory and s/it jumps several-fold instead of erroring. Keep ~1.5 GB VRAM free. IF YOU OOM, in order: (1) confirm sampling is still off; (2) raise layer_offloading_transformer_percent 0.8 -> 1.0; (3) set cache_latents false (keep cache_latents_to_disk); (4) raise lokr_factor 8 -> 16 (smaller network) - do NOT go to 4 on this card until 8 fits with headroom; (5) only then lower resolution to 768. STEPS: meta.step_table is the fork's existing Klein 9B rule (60 steps/image, 1000-2500) written out - 17 images ~1000, 20 ~1200, 30 ~1800, 40 ~2400, 42+ 2500; unchanged at 1024 because no fork doc gives a reason to change it. Community LoKr runs report likeness earlier (around 1000-1500 steps), so test the early checkpoints. BATCH: batch 1; the 16 GB laptop batch plan treats it as UNMEASURED when layer_offloading is on. Set your Trigger Word in the job form. Gated on HF - accept the licence.
